rationale: The buyer is a specific, nameable individual — a dev or indie hacker paying $50–200/month across multiple AI subscriptions — who already pays for software tools and would plausibly pay $5–10/month for a tracker/optimizer. The service (connect your accounts, get a consolidated view and routing recommendations) is genuinely buildable as a Claude-powered form + dashboard + Stripe, and delivery is fully automatable once connected. The deciding factor holding it at 'validate' rather than 'build' is responsiveness_signal: the HN thread shows community interest but no one has paid yet, and the market has free competitors (spreadsheets, manual tracking) plus the barrier of users sharing AI account credentials.
solution_plan: What it is: a lightweight AI subscription tracker that shows a developer all their active AI tool costs in one dashboard and recommends which to cut or consolidate. Build: the factory creates a simple intake form where users paste their subscription costs manually (no OAuth required to start), Claude analyzes the stack and generates a personalized optimization report, delivered via email — landing page + Stripe ($9/month or $5 one-time report) + Claude prompt, shippable in under a week. Sell: post in HN, Indie Hackers, and relevant Discord/Slack communities (devs openly discuss AI spend); outreach goes out only after Youval approves each batch. Maintain: report generation is fully automated via Claude; billing runs on Stripe; support questions are handled by a Claude-powered email responder; Youval's only recurring touch is approving outreach batches and reviewing the weekly revenue summary.
notes: All build gates met (operational_autonomy=8, buildability_with_ai=8, buyer_clarity=7, willingness_to_pay=7). Held at validate because total (6.3) is below min_total_to_build (6.5) and responsiveness_signal is untested. Run a landing page with 50 signups before building the full product.
